content.definitionEn: A person who commits an act that the law treats as a crime.

examples.en: The novel follows a criminal who hides stolen paintings in a warehouse.
examples.vi: Cuốn tiểu thuyết kể về một người phạm tội giấu những bức tranh bị đánh cắp trong nhà kho.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable noun; plural criminals. A suspect is not necessarily a criminal.

content.definitionEn: Connected with crimes or the legal process used to deal with them.

examples.en: The students compared criminal law with the rules governing private contracts.
examples.vi: Các sinh viên so sánh luật hình sự với những quy định điều chỉnh hợp đồng tư.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a noun: criminal law, criminal investigation. Do not confuse criminal with civil.
content.meaningVi: thuộc về tội phạm hoặc luật hình sự

content.definitionEn: Tasks that a teacher expects students to complete outside their lessons.

examples.en: Lan finished her history homework before joining the family meal.
examples.vi: Lan làm xong bài tập lịch sử về nhà trước khi cùng gia đình dùng bữa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable: some homework or a piece of homework, not a homework.

content.definitionEn: A small mammal with a pointed nose and a long thin tail.

examples.en: A mouse slipped behind the cupboard when we opened the kitchen door.
examples.vi: Một con chuột nhỏ lủi ra sau tủ khi chúng tôi mở cửa bếp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; animal plural mice. Mouse names a small rodent, not every rat.

content.definitionEn: A small device moved by hand to control a pointer on a computer screen.

examples.en: Use the mouse to move the photograph into the empty box.
examples.vi: Dùng chuột máy tính để chuyển bức ảnh vào ô trống.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; mice and mouses occur for devices. Click with the mouse; a touchpad is a different device.

content.definitionEn: To enter someone's details in an official record, or give your own details to join something.

examples.en: Mai registered for the evening pottery course at the community centre.
examples.vi: Mai đăng ký khóa học làm gốm buổi tối tại trung tâm cộng đồng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Register for a course; register with an organization; register something in someone's name. Both transitive and intransitive.
content.meaningVi: đăng ký; ghi vào danh sách chính thức

content.definitionEn: A record listing people or items for an official purpose.

examples.en: The caretaker checked the visitor register before closing the building.
examples.vi: Người trông coi kiểm tra sổ đăng ký khách trước khi đóng cửa tòa nhà.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a register of visitors. This record sense differs from a cash register or a language register.
content.meaningVi: sổ hoặc danh sách đăng ký

content.definitionEn: The number that is ten more than sixty.

examples.en: Seventy chairs were arranged around the stage for the guests.
examples.vi: Bảy mươi chiếc ghế được xếp quanh sân khấu cho khách.

content.grammarNotesEn: Cardinal number; seventy guests, not seventies guests. Seventieth is the ordinal form.

content.definitionEn: Organized fighting using weapons between countries or opposing groups.

examples.en: The museum records how the war changed daily life in the town.
examples.vi: Bảo tàng ghi lại cách cuộc chiến tranh làm thay đổi đời sống hằng ngày trong thị trấn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable for a particular conflict, uncountable for warfare generally; at war with, declare war on. No verb is proposed here.

content.definitionEn: To recognize the value of something or feel grateful for it.

examples.en: I appreciate the patience you showed during my first week at work.
examples.vi: Tôi trân trọng sự kiên nhẫn mà bạn đã dành cho tôi trong tuần làm việc đầu tiên.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: appreciate something or doing something; not appreciate to do. Appreciate someone means value them, not simply thank them.

content.definitionEn: To understand a situation and recognize why it matters.

examples.en: After visiting the workshop, we appreciated how much skill the repairs required.
examples.vi: Sau khi đến xưởng, chúng tôi hiểu rõ việc sửa chữa đòi hỏi kỹ năng đến mức nào.

content.grammarNotesEn: Appreciate a difficulty, appreciate that, appreciate how. This understanding sense need not express gratitude.
content.meaningVi: hiểu rõ và nhận thức được tầm quan trọng

content.definitionEn: A unit used to measure volume, especially the amount of a liquid.

examples.en: The label states that the container holds one US gallon of water.
examples.vi: Nhãn ghi rằng bình chứa được một ga-lông Mỹ nước.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a gallon of water, two gallons. US and imperial gallons differ in size; specify the system when precision matters.
content.meaningVi: ga-lông, đơn vị đo thể tích

content.definitionEn: To cause physical damage to a person's or animal's body.

examples.en: The cyclist injured her shoulder when she fell on the gravel path.
examples.vi: Người đi xe đạp bị thương ở vai khi ngã trên lối đi rải sỏi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: injure someone or a body part; injure yourself. Injured is the regular past form.

content.definitionEn: A picture created by applying paint to a surface.

examples.en: The gallery displayed a painting of the harbour at dawn.
examples.vi: Phòng trưng bày giới thiệu một bức tranh vẽ bến cảng lúc bình minh.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a painting, several paintings; a painting of a place.

content.definitionEn: The activity of creating pictures using paint.

examples.en: Painting helps Minh relax after a busy day at the office.
examples.vi: Việc vẽ tranh giúp Minh thư giãn sau một ngày bận rộn ở văn phòng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable activity noun; take up painting. Not the same as an individual painting.

content.definitionEn: The work of putting paint on a surface to colour or protect it.

examples.en: The painting of the wooden fence took longer than we expected.
examples.vi: Việc sơn hàng rào gỗ mất nhiều thời gian hơn chúng tôi dự tính.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable activity; the painting of a wall. This decorating sense differs from making artwork.

content.definitionEn: To move down into a liquid or below its surface.

examples.en: The small stone sank to the bottom of the clear pond.
examples.vi: Viên đá nhỏ chìm xuống đáy ao trong vắt.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive here; sink, sank, sunk. Transitive sink a ship also occurs.

content.definitionEn: A tall upright structure that encloses, divides, or supports a space.

examples.en: We hung the new map on the wall beside the classroom door.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi treo bản đồ mới lên tường bên cạnh cửa lớp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; on a wall for an attached object, against a wall for something leaning on it.

content.definitionEn: One part or feature of something that can be considered separately.

examples.en: The report examines the financial aspect of opening a village library.
examples.vi: Báo cáo xem xét khía cạnh tài chính của việc mở thư viện làng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: an aspect of something. Use different aspects for multiple features.

content.definitionEn: Feeling happy or pleased about something.

examples.en: I was glad to hear that the missing dog had returned home.
examples.vi: Tôi vui khi biết con chó bị lạc đã trở về nhà.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually predicative: glad to do, glad that, glad about something. Not normally a glad person in ordinary description.

content.definitionEn: A shaped object used to lock or unlock something.

examples.en: Hoa kept the spare key in a sealed envelope at her sister's home.
examples.vi: Hoa cất chìa khóa dự phòng trong một phong bì dán kín ở nhà chị gái.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a key to a door, unlock a door with a key.

content.definitionEn: Important because something depends on it for success or understanding.

examples.en: Clear signs were a key part of the station's safety plan.
examples.vi: Biển chỉ dẫn rõ ràng là một phần quan trọng trong kế hoạch an toàn của nhà ga.

content.grammarNotesEn: Often before a noun: a key factor. Also be key to something.

content.definitionEn: To enter information by pressing keys on a keyboard.

examples.en: The clerk keyed the delivery address into the booking system.
examples.vi: Nhân viên nhập địa chỉ giao hàng vào hệ thống đặt dịch vụ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; key information into a system, key in a number. Keyed is the past form.
content.meaningVi: gõ; nhập dữ liệu bằng bàn phím

content.definitionEn: One of the buttons pressed to type or operate a keyboard.

examples.en: Press the space key once between the two words.
examples.vi: Nhấn phím cách một lần giữa hai từ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; press a key. A keyboard has keys; a screen control is normally a button.

content.definitionEn: Something that makes success or understanding possible.

examples.en: Regular practice was the key to her confident performance.
examples.vi: Luyện tập đều đặn là bí quyết giúp cô biểu diễn tự tin.

content.grammarNotesEn: The key to a result; to is a preposition, so the key to improving uses an -ing form.

content.definitionEn: In a way that happens through nature rather than through artificial methods.

examples.en: The pond fills naturally when rainwater flows down the hillside.
examples.vi: Ao đầy nước một cách tự nhiên khi nước mưa chảy xuống sườn đồi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Often modifies a process: grow naturally, occur naturally. Not all natural processes are harmless.

content.definitionEn: Used to show that something is understandable or expected.

examples.en: Naturally, the children were curious about the unopened parcel.
examples.vi: Đương nhiên, bọn trẻ tò mò về gói bưu kiện chưa được mở.

content.grammarNotesEn: Sentence adverb, often separated by a comma. It comments on the statement rather than describing a physical process.
content.meaningVi: đương nhiên; như có thể dự đoán

content.definitionEn: One of the steps used to move between levels in a building.

examples.en: A loose stair creaked whenever someone climbed to the attic.
examples.vi: Một bậc cầu thang bị lỏng kêu cót két mỗi khi có người lên gác mái.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable for one step; stairs usually refers to the whole set: go up the stairs.

content.definitionEn: To open your mouth widely and take a deep breath, often when tired.

examples.en: Nam yawned halfway through the late film and decided to go to bed.
examples.vi: Nam ngáp giữa chừng khi xem bộ phim chiếu muộn rồi quyết định đi ngủ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive; yawned, yawning. A yawn does not always mean boredom.

content.definitionEn: A trained professional who examines and treats teeth and gums.

examples.en: The dentist explained how to clean around the new filling.
examples.vi: Nha sĩ giải thích cách vệ sinh quanh chỗ trám mới.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; see a dentist, make an appointment with a dentist. The dentist's can mean the surgery.

content.definitionEn: To become unconscious for a short time.

examples.en: During the rehearsal, an actor fainted and the performance stopped.
examples.vi: Trong buổi diễn tập, một diễn viên ngất xỉu và buổi diễn dừng lại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive verb; fainted. This is not the adjective meaning weak or difficult to notice.

content.definitionEn: A container with a handle and a spout, used to heat water until it boils.

examples.en: The electric kettle switched off while An arranged cups on the tray.
examples.vi: Ấm đun nước điện tự tắt khi An đang xếp cốc lên khay.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; boil water in a kettle. A kettle heats water; a teapot is primarily for brewing or serving tea.

content.definitionEn: To continue doing something or move on to the next stage.

examples.en: Once everyone had read the plan, the team proceeded with the repairs.
examples.vi: Khi mọi người đã đọc kế hoạch, cả nhóm tiếp tục công việc sửa chữa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive: proceed with something, proceed to do something. Formal compared with continue.

content.definitionEn: To move onwards in a particular direction.

examples.en: Passengers were asked to proceed to the waiting area beside the gate.
examples.vi: Hành khách được yêu cầu đi tiếp đến khu vực chờ bên cạnh cổng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive; proceed to a place or along a route. Common in formal directions.

content.definitionEn: The number that is ten more than twenty.

examples.en: Thirty seedlings fitted into the wooden tray.
examples.vi: Ba mươi cây con vừa trong chiếc khay gỗ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Cardinal number; thirty seedlings. Thirtieth is the ordinal; thirties can name a decade or age range.

content.definitionEn: The conditions of the air outdoors, such as rain, temperature and wind.

examples.en: The weather stayed dry while we repaired the roof.
examples.vi: Thời tiết vẫn khô ráo trong lúc chúng tôi sửa mái nhà.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable: fine weather, a spell of wet weather. Climate describes longer-term patterns.

content.definitionEn: To be worthy of receiving something because of what you have done or what you are like.

examples.en: The volunteers deserve recognition for keeping the shelter open.
examples.vi: Những tình nguyện viên xứng đáng được ghi nhận vì đã duy trì hoạt động của nơi trú tạm.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: deserve something or to do something. Deserve can concern praise or punishment.

content.definitionEn: Something you do repeatedly, often without thinking carefully about it.

examples.en: Checking the gate before bed became a habit for my grandfather.
examples.vi: Việc kiểm tra cổng trước khi ngủ trở thành thói quen của ông tôi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a habit of doing something; get into or break a habit.

content.definitionEn: Not allowed by the law that applies in a place.

examples.en: The fictional detective investigated an illegal trade in stolen artworks.
examples.vi: Vị thám tử trong truyện điều tra hoạt động buôn bán trái phép những tác phẩm nghệ thuật bị đánh cắp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Illegal activity; it is illegal to do something. Lawfulness depends on the applicable law.
content.meaningVi: bất hợp pháp; trái pháp luật

content.definitionEn: Taking place or used outside buildings.

examples.en: The school moved its outdoor concert to the covered courtyard.
examples.vi: Nhà trường chuyển buổi hòa nhạc ngoài trời sang sân có mái che.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a noun: outdoor activities. Outdoors is the adverb: play outdoors.

content.definitionEn: On some occasions, but not every time.

examples.en: My neighbour sometimes brings fresh herbs from her garden.
examples.vi: Người hàng xóm đôi khi mang rau thơm tươi từ vườn nhà đến.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a main verb and after be; also possible at the beginning or end. Not some times meaning several occasions.

content.definitionEn: Following a route with many curves or turns.

examples.en: We followed a winding path between the tea fields.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi đi theo một lối mòn quanh co giữa những đồi chè.

content.grammarNotesEn: Winding road or path; pronounced with the vowel of find, unlike wind meaning moving air.

content.definitionEn: To officially allow a patient to leave hospital care.

examples.en: The hospital discharged the patient after arranging a follow-up appointment.
examples.vi: Bệnh viện cho người bệnh xuất viện sau khi thu xếp một cuộc hẹn tái khám.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; discharge a patient; be discharged from hospital. This does not necessarily mean fully recovered.

content.definitionEn: To officially allow or require someone to leave military service.

examples.en: The navy discharged the sailor at the end of her service.
examples.vi: Hải quân cho nữ thủy thủ xuất ngũ khi cô kết thúc thời gian phục vụ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; discharge someone from the armed forces. Often passive; not necessarily a punishment.

content.definitionEn: To release a liquid or gas from a place or container.

examples.en: The pipe discharges treated water into a storage tank.
examples.vi: Đường ống xả nước đã xử lý vào bể chứa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive or intransitive: discharge water, discharge into a tank. Discharging does not itself imply safe or unsafe quality.

content.definitionEn: To carry out a duty or responsibility that you are expected to fulfil.

examples.en: The treasurer discharged her duties with careful records and regular reports.
examples.vi: Người thủ quỹ thực hiện nhiệm vụ của mình bằng việc ghi chép cẩn thận và báo cáo thường xuyên.

content.grammarNotesEn: Formal transitive use; discharge a duty or responsibility. Distinguish from being discharged from a role.
content.meaningVi: thực hiện nhiệm vụ hoặc nghĩa vụ

content.definitionEn: To require someone to leave a job or position.

examples.en: In the story, the company discharged its manager after an investigation.
examples.vi: Trong câu chuyện, công ty cho người quản lý thôi việc sau một cuộc điều tra.

content.grammarNotesEn: Formal transitive use; discharge an employee; discharge someone from a post. Not the same as completing a duty.

content.definitionEn: Friendly and generous treatment given to visitors or guests.

examples.en: We thanked our hosts for their hospitality during the rainy weekend.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi cảm ơn những người chủ nhà vì sự tiếp đãi chu đáo trong cuối tuần mưa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; show hospitality to someone; thank someone for their hospitality.
content.meaningVi: lòng hiếu khách; sự tiếp đãi chu đáo

content.definitionEn: An amount of material covering a surface or lying above or below another amount.

examples.en: A thin layer of dust covered the unused shelves.
examples.vi: Một lớp bụi mỏng phủ lên những kệ không được dùng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a layer of dust; several layers. The noun does not specify a fixed thickness.

content.definitionEn: A strong thick cord made from strands twisted together.

examples.en: They secured the canvas shelter with ropes before the wind strengthened.
examples.vi: Họ cố định mái trú bằng vải bạt bằng dây thừng trước khi gió mạnh lên.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable for a length or piece; uncountable as material. Tie something with rope.

content.definitionEn: A small insect that lives in a colony and can feed on wood.

examples.en: The carpenter found termites inside the damaged wooden frame.
examples.vi: Người thợ mộc phát hiện mối bên trong khung gỗ bị hư hại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a termite, termites. Termites are insects, not a kind of woodworm larva.

content.definitionEn: Used in a question or negative statement about something expected to happen by now.

examples.en: Have you checked the revised timetable yet?
examples.vi: Bạn đã kiểm tra thời gian biểu đã chỉnh sửa chưa?

content.grammarNotesEn: Often at the end of a question or negative clause; not yet. Present perfect is common but not obligatory in every variety.

content.definitionEn: Used to connect two facts that seem surprising when considered together.

examples.en: The room was small, yet everyone found a comfortable seat.
examples.vi: Căn phòng nhỏ, nhưng mọi người đều tìm được chỗ ngồi thoải mái.

content.grammarNotesEn: Coordinating conjunction; a comma commonly precedes yet when it connects two independent clauses.

content.definitionEn: To act as a rule, instruction or request requires.

examples.en: All exhibitors must comply with the hall's safety instructions.
examples.vi: Tất cả người tham gia trưng bày phải tuân thủ hướng dẫn an toàn của hội trường.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive; comply with something, not comply something. Complied and complying are the inflected forms.

content.definitionEn: Extending far upwards or located far above the ground.

examples.en: A high wall separated the garden from the busy road.
examples.vi: Một bức tường cao ngăn khu vườn với con đường đông đúc.

content.grammarNotesEn: High wall or high shelf; higher, highest. Tall is commonly used for people's height.

content.definitionEn: At a position far above the ground or another reference point.

examples.en: The kite rose high above the roofs.
examples.vi: Cánh diều bay lên cao phía trên những mái nhà.

content.grammarNotesEn: Fly high, climb high; higher and highest also function as adverbs. Highly usually expresses degree rather than physical height.

content.definitionEn: A particularly high level reached by something that changes over time.

examples.en: Attendance reached a new high during the summer exhibition.
examples.vi: Lượng người tham dự đạt mức cao mới trong triển lãm mùa hè.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a new high, an all-time high. The metric and time period should be clear.
content.meaningVi: mức cao; mức cao nhất đạt được

content.definitionEn: To put air or another gas into something so that it becomes larger or firmer.

examples.en: The mechanic inflated the bicycle tyre before checking the valve.
examples.vi: Người thợ bơm phồng lốp xe đạp trước khi kiểm tra van.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive inflate a tyre; also intransitive the tyre inflated. This draft concerns filling with gas, not price inflation.

content.definitionEn: To officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a qualified medical professional.

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a treatment after examining the patient.
examples.vi: Bác sĩ chỉ định điều trị sau khi khám người bệnh.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; prescribe something for someone. Prescribe is different from describe; no dose is specified here.
content.meaningVi: kê đơn; chỉ định điều trị

content.definitionEn: To officially state a rule or requirement that people must follow.

examples.en: The competition rules prescribe the size of every submitted model.
examples.vi: Thể lệ cuộc thi quy định kích thước của từng mô hình dự thi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Formal transitive use; prescribe a method or requirement; prescribe that something be done.

content.definitionEn: Without a paid job, although able and available to work.

examples.en: After the factory closed, he was unemployed for several months.
examples.vi: Sau khi nhà máy đóng cửa, anh thất nghiệp trong vài tháng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually predicative; unemployed workers. The unemployed refers collectively to people without work.

content.definitionEn: The direction where the sun appears to set.

examples.en: The lake lies to the west of the railway station.
examples.vi: Hồ nằm về phía tây của nhà ga.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually the west; to the west of a place. Lowercase for a compass direction, unless part of a proper name.

content.definitionEn: On or towards the western side of a place.

examples.en: The west entrance remains open during the renovation.
examples.vi: Lối vào phía tây vẫn mở trong thời gian sửa chữa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Before a noun: west entrance, west coast. Western is also an adjective, with context-dependent usage.

content.definitionEn: In or towards the western direction.

examples.en: The walkers headed west after crossing the bridge.
examples.vi: Những người đi bộ hướng về phía tây sau khi qua cầu.

content.grammarNotesEn: Head west, travel west; no to is needed before this directional adverb.

content.definitionEn: The protection and careful management of wildlife and natural environments.

examples.en: The village supports forest conservation through a community nursery.
examples.vi: Ngôi làng hỗ trợ việc bảo tồn rừng thông qua một vườn ươm cộng đồng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; nature conservation, conservation of forests. Conservation need not mean excluding all human use.

content.definitionEn: Stories, beliefs and customs passed between generations within a community.

examples.en: The festival included a session on local folklore told by older residents.
examples.vi: Lễ hội có một buổi giới thiệu văn hóa dân gian địa phương do những cư dân lớn tuổi kể lại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; local folklore, a story from folklore. Broader than written folk literature alone.
content.meaningVi: văn hóa dân gian; truyện kể và tín ngưỡng dân gian

content.definitionEn: A product brought into a country from abroad.

examples.en: The shop placed local pottery beside imports from neighbouring countries.
examples.vi: Cửa hàng đặt đồ gốm trong nước cạnh hàng nhập khẩu từ các nước láng giềng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable, often plural imports for goods. Distinguish an import from the activity of import.

content.definitionEn: To bring goods into a country from another country.

examples.en: The company imports fabric from several overseas suppliers.
examples.vi: Công ty nhập khẩu vải từ một số nhà cung cấp ở nước ngoài.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: import goods from a country, import into a market. Opposite direction to export.

content.definitionEn: The activity of bringing goods into a country from abroad.

examples.en: The import of fresh produce requires careful transport planning.
examples.vi: Việc nhập khẩu nông sản tươi đòi hỏi lập kế hoạch vận chuyển cẩn thận.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable activity; the import of goods. In ordinary speech importing is also used.

content.definitionEn: A piece of jewellery designed to be worn around the neck.

examples.en: My aunt wore a silver necklace with a small leaf-shaped pendant.
examples.vi: Cô tôi đeo một dây chuyền bạc có mặt nhỏ hình chiếc lá.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a necklace, necklaces. A pendant is the hanging ornament, not necessarily the whole necklace.

content.definitionEn: To slide unexpectedly and lose firm contact with the surface beneath your feet.

examples.en: He slipped on the wet step but caught the handrail.
examples.vi: Anh trượt chân trên bậc thềm ướt nhưng kịp bám vào tay vịn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive; slip on a surface. Slipped and slipping double the final p; slipping does not always cause a fall.

content.definitionEn: An outdoor area next to a building, often enclosed.

examples.en: The children drew chalk patterns in the school yard.
examples.vi: Bọn trẻ vẽ những hình bằng phấn trong sân trường.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a yard, yards. Yard can be paved or unpaved; use depends on regional context.

content.definitionEn: A unit of length equal to three feet.

examples.en: The tailor measured a yard of blue cloth for the costume.
examples.vi: Người thợ may đo một thước Anh vải màu xanh lam để may trang phục.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a yard of cloth. Yard as a unit differs from an enclosed outdoor yard.
content.meaningVi: thước Anh, đơn vị chiều dài

content.definitionEn: Soft fibres from a cotton plant, used to make thread and fabric.

examples.en: The workers sorted the cotton before it was sent to the spinning mill.
examples.vi: Những người công nhân phân loại bông trước khi chuyển đến nhà máy kéo sợi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable material noun; raw cotton. The plant can be called a cotton plant.

content.definitionEn: Cloth made from cotton fibres.

examples.en: She chose light cotton for the summer curtains.
examples.vi: Cô chọn vải bông nhẹ để may rèm mùa hè.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable material noun; a cotton shirt uses cotton attributively. Fibre and fabric are related but distinct material stages.

content.definitionEn: In a way that is completely accurate or agrees fully with a stated amount or description.

examples.en: The two boards were exactly the same length.
examples.vi: Hai tấm ván có chiều dài bằng nhau chính xác.

content.grammarNotesEn: Exactly the same, exactly right; put exactly before the part whose precision is emphasized.

content.definitionEn: One of the organs in the chest that take air into the body during breathing.

examples.en: The diagram shows the position of each lung inside the chest.
examples.vi: Sơ đồ cho thấy vị trí của từng lá phổi bên trong lồng ngực.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a lung, two lungs. Often plural when discussing breathing.

content.definitionEn: According to information that has been reported, though not confirmed by the speaker.

examples.en: The missing statue was reportedly found in a private collection.
examples.vi: Theo nguồn tin, bức tượng bị mất đã được tìm thấy trong một bộ sưu tập tư nhân.

content.grammarNotesEn: Sentence adverb; reportedly does not establish that a report is true. Often used in news writing.
content.meaningVi: theo nguồn tin; được cho là

content.definitionEn: A written law formally passed by a body with lawmaking authority.

examples.en: The fictional council debated a proposal to revise an old statute.
examples.vi: Hội đồng trong truyện tranh luận về đề xuất sửa đổi một đạo luật cũ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a statute, statutes; under a statute. A statute is not a statue.

content.definitionEn: A message or sign that alerts someone to possible danger or trouble.

examples.en: The flashing light gave a warning that the battery was nearly empty.
examples.vi: Đèn nhấp nháy báo hiệu rằng pin sắp cạn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a warning about something, a warning of danger. A warning can be a signal rather than spoken words.
content.meaningVi: lời cảnh báo; dấu hiệu cảnh báo

content.definitionEn: A railway vehicle in which passengers travel.

examples.en: Our seats were in the last carriage of the morning train.
examples.vi: Chỗ ngồi của chúng tôi ở toa cuối của chuyến tàu buổi sáng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; railway carriage is common in British English; car is common in American English.

content.definitionEn: A vehicle pulled by horses and used to carry people.

examples.en: The restored carriage stood beside a photograph of its former owner.
examples.vi: Chiếc xe ngựa đã được phục chế nằm cạnh ảnh của người chủ trước đây.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a horse-drawn carriage. Distinct from a railway carriage.

content.definitionEn: To make it harder for someone or something to move forward or succeed.

examples.en: Heavy traffic hindered the delivery of the new shelves.
examples.vi: Giao thông đông đúc cản trở việc giao những chiếc kệ mới.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: hinder progress; hinder someone from doing something. Hinder need not mean stop completely.

content.definitionEn: The feeling or opinion that a person or thing creates in someone.

examples.en: The carefully restored hall made a strong impression on the visitors.
examples.vi: Hội trường được phục chế cẩn thận tạo ấn tượng mạnh với khách tham quan.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: make an impression on someone; a first impression.

content.definitionEn: An idea about something formed without complete or certain information.

examples.en: I had the impression that the meeting would finish before lunch.
examples.vi: Tôi có cảm giác cuộc họp sẽ kết thúc trước bữa trưa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Have the impression that; be under the impression that. An impression is not necessarily a confirmed fact.
content.meaningVi: cảm giác; ý nghĩ chưa chắc chắn

content.definitionEn: To take the outer skin off fruit or vegetables.

examples.en: She peeled the carrots and cut them into thin strips.
examples.vi: Cô gọt vỏ cà rốt rồi cắt thành những dải mỏng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: peel a carrot. Peeled and peeling; no peel noun is proposed in this boundary.
content.senseLabelEn: remove a fruit's or vegetable's skin

content.definitionEn: Causing surprise because it is not what someone expected.

examples.en: The quiet garden held a surprising variety of colourful birds.
examples.vi: Khu vườn yên tĩnh có nhiều loài chim sặc sỡ đến mức đáng ngạc nhiên.

content.grammarNotesEn: Surprising describes the cause; surprised describes the person's reaction. It is surprising that...

content.definitionEn: To remain somewhere or delay an action until someone arrives or something happens.

examples.en: We waited for the guide beside the ticket office.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi chờ hướng dẫn viên bên cạnh quầy vé.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually intransitive: wait for someone, wait to do something. Wait on has separate meanings.

content.definitionEn: A period during which someone has to wait.

examples.en: The wait for the next ferry lasted nearly an hour.
examples.vi: Thời gian chờ chuyến phà tiếp theo kéo dài gần một giờ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a long wait; a wait for something. Distinguish the noun from the imperative wait.

content.definitionEn: The ways that people or forces within a group or system affect one another and produce change.

examples.en: A new coordinator changed the dynamics of the small research team.
examples.vi: Một người điều phối mới làm thay đổi các mối tương tác trong nhóm nghiên cứu nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Plural noun in this sense: the dynamics are complex. The science called dynamics has different agreement and meaning.
content.meaningVi: các mối tương tác và tác động trong một nhóm hoặc hệ thống

content.definitionEn: Food and everyday household items bought from a shop.

examples.en: We carried the groceries home in two reusable bags.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi mang thực phẩm và đồ dùng mua được về nhà trong hai túi dùng lại được.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually plural groceries for the goods; grocery often modifies store or shopping.
content.meaningVi: thực phẩm và đồ dùng thiết yếu mua ở cửa hàng

content.definitionEn: Money given to someone on the agreement that they will repay it.

examples.en: The family used a small loan to replace the damaged roof.
examples.vi: Gia đình dùng một khoản vay nhỏ để thay mái nhà bị hỏng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: take out a loan, repay a loan. A loan is not a gift.

content.definitionEn: Used to introduce a fact that remains true despite what has just been said.

examples.en: The route was longer than expected; nevertheless, we arrived before sunset.
examples.vi: Tuyến đường dài hơn dự kiến; dù vậy, chúng tôi đến nơi trước khi mặt trời lặn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Linking adverb, often with a comma. Use a semicolon or full stop between independent clauses rather than a comma alone.

content.definitionEn: On very few occasions.

examples.en: The old clock seldom needed adjustment.
examples.vi: Chiếc đồng hồ cũ hiếm khi cần chỉnh lại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Frequency adverb, usually before the main verb. Initial seldom triggers inversion in formal clauses: seldom did they visit.

content.definitionEn: Measuring a large distance from one side to the other.

examples.en: The wide doorway allowed the table to pass through easily.
examples.vi: Ô cửa rộng giúp chiếc bàn được đưa qua dễ dàng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Wide, wider, widest; a metre wide. Width is the related noun.

content.definitionEn: The collection of sacred writings used in Christianity.

examples.en: The display included a Bible with handwritten notes in the margins.
examples.vi: Khu trưng bày có một cuốn Kinh Thánh với những ghi chú viết tay bên lề.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually capitalized Bible for the Christian scripture; the Bible for the collection, a Bible for a physical copy.

content.definitionEn: A group of organizations joined together for shared purposes while keeping some independence.

examples.en: Several cycling clubs formed a federation to organize regional races.
examples.vi: Một số câu lạc bộ xe đạp thành lập một liên đoàn để tổ chức các cuộc đua trong vùng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a federation of clubs. Member bodies retain some separate organization.

content.definitionEn: A country made up of states or regions that share a central government while retaining some powers of their own.

examples.en: In the fictional federation, each state managed its own school system.
examples.vi: Trong liên bang hư cấu, mỗi bang quản lý hệ thống trường học riêng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a federation of states. Not every international organization is a federation.

content.definitionEn: Beliefs about what behaviour is right or wrong.

examples.en: The story asks how personal morals influence difficult choices.
examples.vi: Câu chuyện đặt câu hỏi về cách các nguyên tắc đạo đức cá nhân ảnh hưởng đến những lựa chọn khó khăn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Plural noun: someone's morals. Distinguish from the moral of a story, its lesson.

content.definitionEn: To a noticeable but not extreme degree, especially in British English.

examples.en: The new reading room is quite spacious, though the main hall is larger.
examples.vi: Phòng đọc mới khá rộng rãi, dù hội trường chính rộng hơn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Before gradable adjectives or adverbs; the strength varies with context, intonation and variety of English.

content.definitionEn: Completely or entirely, especially with a word describing a complete state.

examples.en: Your guess was quite correct: the parcel contained the missing notebook.
examples.vi: Bạn đoán hoàn toàn đúng: gói bưu kiện chứa cuốn sổ bị thất lạc.

content.grammarNotesEn: Quite right, quite certain; not quite means not completely. Do not assume every use of quite has the same strength.

content.definitionEn: Able to do something well through knowledge or practice, or showing that ability.

examples.en: The skillful carpenter repaired the chair without changing its shape.
examples.vi: Người thợ mộc khéo léo sửa chiếc ghế mà không làm thay đổi hình dạng của nó.

content.grammarNotesEn: Skillful at doing something; skillful is usual American spelling, skilful usual British spelling.

content.definitionEn: A unit of language that carries meaning and can be spoken or written.

examples.en: The teacher wrote each new word beside a small drawing.
examples.vi: Giáo viên viết từng từ mới bên cạnh một hình vẽ nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a word, words; a word for something. This definition does not require every word to have spaces around it.

content.definitionEn: Very surprised by something unexpected or impressive.

examples.en: We were amazed at the detail in the tiny wooden model.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi kinh ngạc trước những chi tiết trong mô hình gỗ nhỏ xíu.

content.grammarNotesEn: Amazed at or by something; amazed to do, amazed that. Amazing describes the cause.

content.definitionEn: Goods transported in large quantities, especially by ship, train or truck.

examples.en: The train carried freight overnight while passenger services had stopped.
examples.vi: Đoàn tàu chở hàng hóa qua đêm trong khi các chuyến chở khách đã ngừng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; freight transport, a freight train. Cargo overlaps in meaning, but neither word creates a canonical identity claim.

content.definitionEn: Following a clear and consistent line of reasoning.

examples.en: Her explanation gave a logical reason for changing the timetable.
examples.vi: Lời giải thích của cô đưa ra lý do hợp lý cho việc đổi thời gian biểu.

content.grammarNotesEn: A logical argument or conclusion; logical does not by itself guarantee that every starting assumption is true.

content.definitionEn: Belonging to a time before written records of history.

examples.en: The museum displayed prehistoric tools found near the river.
examples.vi: Bảo tàng trưng bày những công cụ thời tiền sử được tìm thấy gần sông.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a noun; prehistoric people or tools. The relevant period varies between regions.

content.definitionEn: To join or attach material by making stitches with a needle and thread.

examples.en: Grandmother sewed a new pocket onto my gardening apron.
examples.vi: Bà khâu thêm một chiếc túi mới vào tạp dề làm vườn của tôi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Sew, sewed, sewn or sewed; sew something onto something. Sewing can be by hand or machine.

content.definitionEn: Having the bright colour commonly seen in a ripe lemon.

examples.en: A yellow ribbon marked the path to the meeting place.
examples.vi: Một dải ruy băng màu vàng đánh dấu lối đến điểm hẹn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Yellow can precede a noun or follow be; yellowish means somewhat yellow.
content.senseLabelEn: having the colour of a lemon

content.definitionEn: The colour commonly seen in a ripe lemon.

examples.en: She added a little yellow to the green paint.
examples.vi: Cô thêm một ít màu vàng vào sơn màu xanh lá.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually uncountable for the colour; a yellow can refer to a particular shade.

content.definitionEn: Consisting of two similar parts or providing for two people.

examples.en: The studio has a double door opening onto the courtyard.
examples.vi: Xưởng có một cửa hai cánh mở ra sân.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a noun: double door, double room. Exact meaning depends on the noun.
content.meaningVi: đôi; có hai phần tương tự

content.definitionEn: Twice as much or as many as a stated or understood amount.

examples.en: The larger pot holds double the amount of water.
examples.vi: Chiếc nồi lớn chứa lượng nước gấp đôi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Double the amount or double my salary; followed by a noun phrase identifying the quantity.
content.senseLabelEn: twice the amount before a noun

content.definitionEn: An amount that is twice another amount already understood.

examples.en: The first box held twelve tools, and the second held double.
examples.vi: Hộp thứ nhất chứa mười hai dụng cụ, còn hộp thứ hai chứa gấp đôi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Pronoun use stands without a following noun when the reference quantity is clear.

content.definitionEn: To become twice as large, or make something twice as large.

examples.en: The club doubled its membership after opening a weekend class.
examples.vi: Câu lạc bộ tăng gấp đôi số thành viên sau khi mở một lớp cuối tuần.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive or intransitive: double the number, the number doubled. Doubled is regular.
content.meaningVi: tăng gấp đôi; làm tăng gấp đôi
content.senseLabelEn: become or make twice as much

content.definitionEn: At twice the usual or stated amount.

examples.en: Visitors paid double during the special evening session.
examples.vi: Khách trả gấp đôi trong buổi đặc biệt vào tối đó.

content.grammarNotesEn: Pay double, cost double; modifies the verb rather than a following noun.

content.definitionEn: Accepted ways of behaving politely in a particular social setting.

examples.en: The guide explained dining etiquette before the formal meal.
examples.vi: Người hướng dẫn giải thích phép lịch sự khi ăn uống trước bữa ăn trang trọng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; dining etiquette, rules of etiquette. Expectations vary by setting and culture.
content.meaningVi: phép lịch sự; nghi thức ứng xử

content.definitionEn: To twist together, or cause things to twist around one another.

examples.en: The bean stems intertwined around the wooden support.
examples.vi: Những thân cây đậu quấn vào nhau quanh giá đỡ bằng gỗ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive or intransitive; intertwine something with something; be intertwined. Also used figuratively for connected lives or issues.
content.meaningVi: đan vào nhau; quấn vào nhau

content.definitionEn: The remaining parts of buildings that have been destroyed or have fallen into disrepair.

examples.en: The path led to the ruins of a small stone tower.
examples.vi: Lối mòn dẫn đến tàn tích của một tháp đá nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Plural noun: the ruins of a building; the ruins are visible. Distinguish from uncountable ruin meaning destruction.

content.definitionEn: Towards a side rather than straight forwards or backwards.

examples.en: Move the cupboard sideways to clear the doorway.
examples.vi: Dịch chiếc tủ sang một bên để thông lối cửa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Move or step sideways; also sidewise in some usage. Sideways is not the same direction as backwards.
content.meaningVi: sang một bên; theo chiều ngang

content.definitionEn: During the time that another action or situation is happening.

examples.en: Whilst the soup simmered, I prepared the salad.
examples.vi: Trong khi súp sôi liu riu, tôi chuẩn bị món rau trộn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Whilst introduces a clause; mainly British English and often more formal than while.

content.definitionEn: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with the main statement.

examples.en: Whilst the design is simple, it is difficult to build accurately.
examples.vi: Mặc dù thiết kế đơn giản, việc dựng nó cho chính xác lại khó.

content.grammarNotesEn: Contrastive whilst is close to although; context distinguishes it from simultaneous-time whilst.

content.definitionEn: An area of a town or country with a particular boundary or character.

examples.en: The guide showed us the old market district near the river.
examples.vi: Người hướng dẫn đưa chúng tôi đến khu chợ cũ gần sông.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a shopping district or an administrative district. Vietnamese quận/huyện depends on the actual administrative system.

content.definitionEn: To recognize in advance that something may happen.

examples.en: The organizers foresaw delays and allowed extra time for the journey.
examples.vi: Ban tổ chức dự liệu việc chậm trễ và dành thêm thời gian cho hành trình.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; foresee something or foresee that; foresaw, foreseen. Foreseeing is anticipation, not certain knowledge of the future.

content.definitionEn: More and more as time passes.

examples.en: The library became increasingly popular after extending its opening hours.
examples.vi: Thư viện ngày càng được ưa chuộng sau khi kéo dài giờ mở cửa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Before an adjective or adverb; also before a main verb. Increasingly describes a trend rather than one fixed degree.

content.definitionEn: A piece of land surrounded by water on most sides but joined to a larger land area.

examples.en: A narrow road connects the peninsula's villages with the mainland.
examples.vi: Một con đường hẹp nối các làng trên bán đảo với phần đất liền chính.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a peninsula, peninsulas. A peninsula remains connected to land, unlike an island.

content.definitionEn: Serious and firm in expecting people to behave properly.

examples.en: The coach gave the noisy players a stern look.
examples.vi: Huấn luyện viên nhìn những cầu thủ ồn ào bằng ánh mắt nghiêm nghị.

content.grammarNotesEn: Stern look or warning; stern with someone. This adjective is distinct from the ship-part noun.

content.definitionEn: A substance that is solid at ordinary temperatures and softens or melts when heated, often used for candles or polish.

examples.en: The artist warmed the wax before shaping the small model.
examples.vi: Người nghệ sĩ làm ấm sáp trước khi tạo hình cho mô hình nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually uncountable material noun; a piece of wax. A wax can name a particular type.
content.senseLabelEn: solid substance that softens with heat

content.definitionEn: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.

examples.en: The new route is a better choice for cyclists.
examples.vi: Tuyến đường mới là lựa chọn tốt hơn cho người đi xe đạp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Comparative of good; better than, a better option. Do not use more better.

content.definitionEn: In a more successful, satisfactory or effective way.

examples.en: The class worked better after the desks were rearranged.
examples.vi: Lớp làm việc hiệu quả hơn sau khi các bàn được sắp xếp lại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Comparative of well; do something better, better than before. Better modifies the action here.

content.definitionEn: A more favourable state or outcome.

examples.en: The change in leadership was a change for the better.
examples.vi: Việc thay đổi người lãnh đạo là một sự thay đổi theo chiều hướng tốt hơn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Noun use is common in for the better. Do not generalize this pattern to an ordinary countable a better.
content.meaningVi: điều tốt hơn; sự cải thiện

content.definitionEn: Containing a lot of water vapour, especially of air or weather.

examples.en: The air felt humid after the afternoon shower.
examples.vi: Không khí có cảm giác ẩm sau cơn mưa rào buổi chiều.

content.grammarNotesEn: Humid air or weather; humidity is the noun. Humid does not necessarily mean a surface is wet.
content.senseLabelEn: having much moisture in the air

content.definitionEn: A compact piece of a solid substance, often with an uneven shape.

examples.en: A lump of clay remained at the bottom of the bucket.
examples.vi: Một cục đất sét còn lại ở đáy xô.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a lump of something. This material-piece sense does not identify a medical swelling.

content.definitionEn: The reddish-brown material that can form on iron or steel when it reacts with oxygen and moisture.

examples.en: Rust had formed around the old gate's hinges.
examples.vi: Rỉ sét đã hình thành quanh những bản lề của cánh cổng cũ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually uncountable; a patch of rust. Rusty is the adjective; the verb rust is a separate POS proposal.

content.definitionEn: Seriously affected by illness, distress or another harmful event.

examples.en: The storm-stricken village received blankets and clean water.
examples.vi: Ngôi làng chịu ảnh hưởng nặng nề của bão nhận được chăn và nước sạch.

content.grammarNotesEn: Stricken with or by something; compounds include grief-stricken. Use struck for the ordinary past participle meaning hit.
content.meaningVi: bị ảnh hưởng nặng nề; lâm vào đau khổ

content.definitionEn: The part of life when someone is young.

examples.en: In her youth, my grandmother travelled between villages by bicycle.
examples.vi: Thời trẻ, bà tôi đi lại giữa các làng bằng xe đạp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable: in someone's youth. Youthful is the related adjective.

content.definitionEn: A young person, especially a young man in some uses.

examples.en: A youth from the village helped the visitors find the path.
examples.vi: Một thanh niên trong làng giúp khách tìm lối đi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a youth, youths. Youths can sound formal or distancing; young people is often more neutral.

content.definitionEn: Young people considered together as a social group.

examples.en: The council invited local youth to discuss the new sports centre.
examples.vi: Hội đồng mời giới trẻ địa phương thảo luận về trung tâm thể thao mới.

content.grammarNotesEn: Collective use; local youth or the youth of a place. Agreement can vary by construction and variety.

content.definitionEn: With intention rather than by accident.

examples.en: She deliberately left the final page blank for the reader's notes.
examples.vi: Cô chủ ý để trống trang cuối cho ghi chú của người đọc.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before the main verb or after it for emphasis. Deliberately does not necessarily imply bad intentions.

content.definitionEn: To please someone strongly and hold their interest.

examples.en: The storyteller enchanted the audience with a tale about a wandering fox.
examples.vi: Người kể chuyện cuốn hút khán giả bằng câu chuyện về một con cáo lang thang.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; enchant someone with something; be enchanted by. This delight sense differs from casting a magical spell.

content.definitionEn: Not working, active or in use at a particular time.

examples.en: The sewing machine stood idle while its owner waited for a new part.
examples.vi: Máy may không hoạt động trong lúc người chủ chờ một linh kiện mới.

content.grammarNotesEn: Idle equipment; remain or stand idle. Idle does not always mean a person is lazy.

content.definitionEn: Involving fewer working hours than a normal full-time schedule.

examples.en: Linh found a part-time job at the neighbourhood bookshop.
examples.vi: Linh tìm được một công việc bán thời gian tại hiệu sách trong khu phố.

content.grammarNotesEn: Hyphenated before a noun: part-time job. Exact hours depend on the work arrangement.
content.senseLabelEn: working fewer hours than a full schedule

content.definitionEn: For fewer working hours than a normal full-time schedule.

examples.en: He works part-time while attending an evening course.
examples.vi: Anh làm việc theo chế độ bán thời gian trong khi học một khóa buổi tối.

content.grammarNotesEn: Work part-time; hyphenated form is common. Do not infer a fixed weekly number of hours.
content.meaningVi: theo chế độ bán thời gian

content.definitionEn: A person who commits an act that the law treats as a crime.

examples.en: The novel follows a criminal who hides stolen paintings in a warehouse.
examples.vi: Cuốn tiểu thuyết kể về một người phạm tội giấu những bức tranh bị đánh cắp trong nhà kho.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable noun; plural criminals. A suspect is not necessarily a criminal.

content.definitionEn: Connected with crimes or the legal process used to deal with them.

examples.en: The students compared criminal law with the rules governing private contracts.
examples.vi: Các sinh viên so sánh luật hình sự với những quy định điều chỉnh hợp đồng tư.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a noun: criminal law, criminal investigation. Do not confuse criminal with civil.
content.meaningVi: thuộc về tội phạm hoặc luật hình sự

content.definitionEn: Tasks that a teacher expects students to complete outside their lessons.

examples.en: Lan finished her history homework before joining the family meal.
examples.vi: Lan làm xong bài tập lịch sử về nhà trước khi cùng gia đình dùng bữa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable: some homework or a piece of homework, not a homework.

content.definitionEn: A small mammal with a pointed nose and a long thin tail.

examples.en: A mouse slipped behind the cupboard when we opened the kitchen door.
examples.vi: Một con chuột nhỏ lủi ra sau tủ khi chúng tôi mở cửa bếp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; animal plural mice. Mouse names a small rodent, not every rat.

content.definitionEn: A small device moved by hand to control a pointer on a computer screen.

examples.en: Use the mouse to move the photograph into the empty box.
examples.vi: Dùng chuột máy tính để chuyển bức ảnh vào ô trống.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; mice and mouses occur for devices. Click with the mouse; a touchpad is a different device.

content.definitionEn: To enter someone's details in an official record, or give your own details to join something.

examples.en: Mai registered for the evening pottery course at the community centre.
examples.vi: Mai đăng ký khóa học làm gốm buổi tối tại trung tâm cộng đồng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Register for a course; register with an organization; register something in someone's name. Both transitive and intransitive.
content.meaningVi: đăng ký; ghi vào danh sách chính thức

content.definitionEn: A record listing people or items for an official purpose.

examples.en: The caretaker checked the visitor register before closing the building.
examples.vi: Người trông coi kiểm tra sổ đăng ký khách trước khi đóng cửa tòa nhà.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a register of visitors. This record sense differs from a cash register or a language register.
content.meaningVi: sổ hoặc danh sách đăng ký

content.definitionEn: The number that is ten more than sixty.

examples.en: Seventy chairs were arranged around the stage for the guests.
examples.vi: Bảy mươi chiếc ghế được xếp quanh sân khấu cho khách.

content.grammarNotesEn: Cardinal number; seventy guests, not seventies guests. Seventieth is the ordinal form.

content.definitionEn: Organized fighting using weapons between countries or opposing groups.

examples.en: The museum records how the war changed daily life in the town.
examples.vi: Bảo tàng ghi lại cách cuộc chiến tranh làm thay đổi đời sống hằng ngày trong thị trấn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable for a particular conflict, uncountable for warfare generally; at war with, declare war on.

content.definitionEn: To recognize the value of something or feel grateful for it.

examples.en: I appreciate the patience you showed during my first week at work.
examples.vi: Tôi trân trọng sự kiên nhẫn mà bạn đã dành cho tôi trong tuần làm việc đầu tiên.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: appreciate something or doing something; not appreciate to do. Appreciate someone means value them, not simply thank them.

content.definitionEn: To understand a situation and recognize why it matters.

examples.en: After visiting the workshop, we appreciated how much skill the repairs required.
examples.vi: Sau khi đến xưởng, chúng tôi hiểu rõ việc sửa chữa đòi hỏi kỹ năng đến mức nào.

content.grammarNotesEn: Appreciate a difficulty, appreciate that, appreciate how. This understanding sense need not express gratitude.
content.meaningVi: hiểu rõ và nhận thức được tầm quan trọng

content.definitionEn: A unit used to measure volume, especially the amount of a liquid.

examples.en: The label states that the container holds one US gallon of water.
examples.vi: Nhãn ghi rằng bình chứa được một ga-lông Mỹ nước.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a gallon of water, two gallons. US and imperial gallons differ in size; specify the system when precision matters.
content.meaningVi: ga-lông, đơn vị đo thể tích

content.definitionEn: To cause physical damage to a person's or animal's body.

examples.en: The cyclist injured her shoulder when she fell on the gravel path.
examples.vi: Người đi xe đạp bị thương ở vai khi ngã trên lối đi rải sỏi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: injure someone or a body part; injure yourself. Injured is the regular past form.

content.definitionEn: A picture created by applying paint to a surface.

examples.en: The gallery displayed a painting of the harbour at dawn.
examples.vi: Phòng trưng bày giới thiệu một bức tranh vẽ bến cảng lúc bình minh.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a painting, several paintings; a painting of a place.

content.definitionEn: The activity of creating pictures using paint.

examples.en: Painting helps Minh relax after a busy day at the office.
examples.vi: Việc vẽ tranh giúp Minh thư giãn sau một ngày bận rộn ở văn phòng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable activity noun; take up painting. Not the same as an individual painting.

content.definitionEn: The work of putting paint on a surface to colour or protect it.

examples.en: The painting of the wooden fence took longer than we expected.
examples.vi: Việc sơn hàng rào gỗ mất nhiều thời gian hơn chúng tôi dự tính.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable activity; the painting of a wall. This decorating sense differs from making artwork.

content.definitionEn: To move down into a liquid or below its surface.

examples.en: The small stone sank to the bottom of the clear pond.
examples.vi: Viên đá nhỏ chìm xuống đáy ao trong vắt.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive here; sink, sank, sunk. Transitive sink a ship also occurs.

content.definitionEn: A tall upright structure that encloses, divides, or supports a space.

examples.en: We hung the new map on the wall beside the classroom door.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi treo bản đồ mới lên tường bên cạnh cửa lớp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; on a wall for an attached object, against a wall for something leaning on it.

content.definitionEn: One part or feature of something that can be considered separately.

examples.en: The report examines the financial aspect of opening a village library.
examples.vi: Báo cáo xem xét khía cạnh tài chính của việc mở thư viện làng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: an aspect of something. Use different aspects for multiple features.

content.definitionEn: Feeling happy or pleased about something.

examples.en: I was glad to hear that the missing dog had returned home.
examples.vi: Tôi vui khi biết con chó bị lạc đã trở về nhà.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually predicative: glad to do, glad that, glad about something. Not normally a glad person in ordinary description.

content.definitionEn: A shaped object used to lock or unlock something.

examples.en: Hoa kept the spare key in a sealed envelope at her sister's home.
examples.vi: Hoa cất chìa khóa dự phòng trong một phong bì dán kín ở nhà chị gái.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a key to a door, unlock a door with a key.

content.definitionEn: Important because something depends on it for success or understanding.

examples.en: Clear signs were a key part of the station's safety plan.
examples.vi: Biển chỉ dẫn rõ ràng là một phần quan trọng trong kế hoạch an toàn của nhà ga.

content.grammarNotesEn: Often before a noun: a key factor. Also be key to something.

content.definitionEn: To enter information by pressing keys on a keyboard.

examples.en: The clerk keyed the delivery address into the booking system.
examples.vi: Nhân viên nhập địa chỉ giao hàng vào hệ thống đặt dịch vụ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; key information into a system, key in a number. Keyed is the past form.
content.meaningVi: gõ; nhập dữ liệu bằng bàn phím

content.definitionEn: One of the buttons pressed to type or operate a keyboard.

examples.en: Press the space key once between the two words.
examples.vi: Nhấn phím cách một lần giữa hai từ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; press a key. A keyboard has keys; a screen control is normally a button.

content.definitionEn: Something that makes success or understanding possible.

examples.en: Regular practice was the key to her confident performance.
examples.vi: Luyện tập đều đặn là bí quyết giúp cô biểu diễn tự tin.

content.grammarNotesEn: The key to a result; to is a preposition, so the key to improving uses an -ing form.

content.definitionEn: In a way that happens through nature rather than through artificial methods.

examples.en: The pond fills naturally when rainwater flows down the hillside.
examples.vi: Ao đầy nước một cách tự nhiên khi nước mưa chảy xuống sườn đồi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Often modifies a process: grow naturally, occur naturally. Not all natural processes are harmless.

content.definitionEn: Used to show that something is understandable or expected.

examples.en: Naturally, the children were curious about the unopened parcel.
examples.vi: Đương nhiên, bọn trẻ tò mò về gói bưu kiện chưa được mở.

content.grammarNotesEn: Sentence adverb, often separated by a comma. It comments on the statement rather than describing a physical process.
content.meaningVi: đương nhiên; như có thể dự đoán

content.definitionEn: One of the steps used to move between levels in a building.

examples.en: A loose stair creaked whenever someone climbed to the attic.
examples.vi: Một bậc cầu thang bị lỏng kêu cót két mỗi khi có người lên gác mái.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable for one step; stairs usually refers to the whole set: go up the stairs.

content.definitionEn: To open your mouth widely and take a deep breath, often when tired.

examples.en: Nam yawned halfway through the late film and decided to go to bed.
examples.vi: Nam ngáp giữa chừng khi xem bộ phim chiếu muộn rồi quyết định đi ngủ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive; yawned, yawning. A yawn does not always mean boredom.

content.definitionEn: A trained professional who examines and treats teeth and gums.

examples.en: The dentist explained how to clean around the new filling.
examples.vi: Nha sĩ giải thích cách vệ sinh quanh chỗ trám mới.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; see a dentist, make an appointment with a dentist. The dentist's can mean the surgery.

content.definitionEn: To become unconscious for a short time.

examples.en: During the rehearsal, an actor fainted and the performance stopped.
examples.vi: Trong buổi diễn tập, một diễn viên ngất xỉu và buổi diễn dừng lại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive verb; fainted. This is not the adjective meaning weak or difficult to notice.

content.definitionEn: A container with a handle and a spout, used to heat water until it boils.

examples.en: The electric kettle switched off while An arranged cups on the tray.
examples.vi: Ấm đun nước điện tự tắt khi An đang xếp cốc lên khay.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; boil water in a kettle. A kettle heats water; a teapot is primarily for brewing or serving tea.

content.definitionEn: To continue doing something or move on to the next stage.

examples.en: Once everyone had read the plan, the team proceeded with the repairs.
examples.vi: Khi mọi người đã đọc kế hoạch, cả nhóm tiếp tục công việc sửa chữa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive: proceed with something, proceed to do something. Formal compared with continue.

content.definitionEn: To move onwards in a particular direction.

examples.en: Passengers were asked to proceed to the waiting area beside the gate.
examples.vi: Hành khách được yêu cầu đi tiếp đến khu vực chờ bên cạnh cổng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive; proceed to a place or along a route. Common in formal directions.

content.definitionEn: The number that is ten more than twenty.

examples.en: Thirty seedlings fitted into the wooden tray.
examples.vi: Ba mươi cây con vừa trong chiếc khay gỗ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Cardinal number; thirty seedlings. Thirtieth is the ordinal; thirties can name a decade or age range.

content.definitionEn: The conditions of the air outdoors, such as rain, temperature and wind.

examples.en: The weather stayed dry while we repaired the roof.
examples.vi: Thời tiết vẫn khô ráo trong lúc chúng tôi sửa mái nhà.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable: fine weather, a spell of wet weather. Climate describes longer-term patterns.

content.definitionEn: To be worthy of receiving something because of what you have done or what you are like.

examples.en: The volunteers deserve recognition for keeping the shelter open.
examples.vi: Những tình nguyện viên xứng đáng được ghi nhận vì đã duy trì hoạt động của nơi trú tạm.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: deserve something or to do something. Deserve can concern praise or punishment.

content.definitionEn: Something you do repeatedly, often without thinking carefully about it.

examples.en: Checking the gate before bed became a habit for my grandfather.
examples.vi: Việc kiểm tra cổng trước khi ngủ trở thành thói quen của ông tôi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a habit of doing something; get into or break a habit.

content.definitionEn: Not allowed by the law that applies in a place.

examples.en: The fictional detective investigated an illegal trade in stolen artworks.
examples.vi: Vị thám tử trong truyện điều tra hoạt động buôn bán trái phép những tác phẩm nghệ thuật bị đánh cắp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Illegal activity; it is illegal to do something. Lawfulness depends on the applicable law.
content.meaningVi: bất hợp pháp; trái pháp luật

content.definitionEn: Taking place or used outside buildings.

examples.en: The school moved its outdoor concert to the covered courtyard.
examples.vi: Nhà trường chuyển buổi hòa nhạc ngoài trời sang sân có mái che.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a noun: outdoor activities. Outdoors is the adverb: play outdoors.

content.definitionEn: On some occasions, but not every time.

examples.en: My neighbour sometimes brings fresh herbs from her garden.
examples.vi: Người hàng xóm đôi khi mang rau thơm tươi từ vườn nhà đến.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a main verb and after be; also possible at the beginning or end. Not some times meaning several occasions.

content.definitionEn: Following a route with many curves or turns.

examples.en: We followed a winding path between the tea fields.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi đi theo một lối mòn quanh co giữa những đồi chè.

content.grammarNotesEn: Winding road or path; pronounced with the vowel of find, unlike wind meaning moving air.

content.definitionEn: To officially allow a patient to leave hospital care.

examples.en: The hospital discharged the patient after arranging a follow-up appointment.
examples.vi: Bệnh viện cho người bệnh xuất viện sau khi thu xếp một cuộc hẹn tái khám.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; discharge a patient; be discharged from hospital. This does not necessarily mean fully recovered.

content.definitionEn: To officially allow or require someone to leave military service.

examples.en: The navy discharged the sailor at the end of her service.
examples.vi: Hải quân cho nữ thủy thủ xuất ngũ khi cô kết thúc thời gian phục vụ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; discharge someone from the armed forces. Often passive; not necessarily a punishment.

content.definitionEn: To release a liquid or gas from a place or container.

examples.en: The pipe discharges treated water into a storage tank.
examples.vi: Đường ống xả nước đã xử lý vào bể chứa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive or intransitive: discharge water, discharge into a tank. Discharging does not itself imply safe or unsafe quality.

content.definitionEn: To carry out a duty or responsibility that you are expected to fulfil.

examples.en: The treasurer discharged her duties with careful records and regular reports.
examples.vi: Người thủ quỹ thực hiện nhiệm vụ của mình bằng việc ghi chép cẩn thận và báo cáo thường xuyên.

content.grammarNotesEn: Formal transitive use; discharge a duty or responsibility. Distinguish from being discharged from a role.
content.meaningVi: thực hiện nhiệm vụ hoặc nghĩa vụ

content.definitionEn: To require someone to leave a job or position.

examples.en: In the story, the company discharged its manager after an investigation.
examples.vi: Trong câu chuyện, công ty cho người quản lý thôi việc sau một cuộc điều tra.

content.grammarNotesEn: Formal transitive use; discharge an employee; discharge someone from a post. Not the same as completing a duty.

content.definitionEn: Friendly and generous treatment given to visitors or guests.

examples.en: We thanked our hosts for their hospitality during the rainy weekend.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi cảm ơn những người chủ nhà vì sự tiếp đãi chu đáo trong cuối tuần mưa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; show hospitality to someone; thank someone for their hospitality.
content.meaningVi: lòng hiếu khách; sự tiếp đãi chu đáo

content.definitionEn: An amount of material covering a surface or lying above or below another amount.

examples.en: A thin layer of dust covered the unused shelves.
examples.vi: Một lớp bụi mỏng phủ lên những kệ không được dùng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a layer of dust; several layers. The noun does not specify a fixed thickness.

content.definitionEn: A strong thick cord made from strands twisted together.

examples.en: They secured the canvas shelter with ropes before the wind strengthened.
examples.vi: Họ dùng dây thừng cố định mái trú bằng vải bạt trước khi gió mạnh lên.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable for a length or piece; uncountable as material. Tie something with rope.

content.definitionEn: A small insect that lives in a colony and can feed on wood.

examples.en: The carpenter found termites inside the damaged wooden frame.
examples.vi: Người thợ mộc phát hiện mối bên trong khung gỗ bị hư hại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a termite, termites. Termites are insects, not a kind of woodworm larva.

content.definitionEn: Used in a question or negative statement about something expected to happen by now.

examples.en: Have you checked the revised timetable yet?
examples.vi: Bạn đã kiểm tra thời gian biểu đã chỉnh sửa chưa?

content.grammarNotesEn: Often at the end of a question or negative clause; not yet. Present perfect is common but not obligatory in every variety.

content.definitionEn: Used to connect two facts that seem surprising when considered together.

examples.en: The room was small, yet everyone found a comfortable seat.
examples.vi: Căn phòng nhỏ, nhưng mọi người đều tìm được chỗ ngồi thoải mái.

content.grammarNotesEn: Coordinating conjunction; a comma commonly precedes yet when it connects two independent clauses.

content.definitionEn: To act as a rule, instruction or request requires.

examples.en: All exhibitors must comply with the hall's safety instructions.
examples.vi: Tất cả người tham gia trưng bày phải tuân thủ hướng dẫn an toàn của hội trường.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive; comply with something, not comply something. Complied and complying are the inflected forms.

content.definitionEn: Extending far upwards or located far above the ground.

examples.en: A high wall separated the garden from the busy road.
examples.vi: Một bức tường cao ngăn khu vườn với con đường đông đúc.

content.grammarNotesEn: High wall or high shelf; higher, highest. Tall is commonly used for people's height.

content.definitionEn: At a position far above the ground or another reference point.

examples.en: The kite rose high above the roofs.
examples.vi: Cánh diều bay lên cao phía trên những mái nhà.

content.grammarNotesEn: Fly high, climb high; higher and highest also function as adverbs. Highly usually expresses degree rather than physical height.

content.definitionEn: A particularly high level reached by something that changes over time.

examples.en: Attendance reached a new high during the summer exhibition.
examples.vi: Lượng người tham dự đạt mức cao mới trong triển lãm mùa hè.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a new high, an all-time high. The metric and time period should be clear.
content.meaningVi: mức cao; mức cao nhất đạt được

content.definitionEn: To put air or another gas into something so that it becomes larger or firmer.

examples.en: The mechanic inflated the bicycle tyre before checking the valve.
examples.vi: Người thợ bơm phồng lốp xe đạp trước khi kiểm tra van.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive inflate a tyre; also intransitive the tyre inflated. This draft concerns filling with gas, not price inflation.

content.definitionEn: To officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a qualified medical professional.

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a treatment after examining the patient.
examples.vi: Bác sĩ chỉ định điều trị sau khi khám người bệnh.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; prescribe something for someone. Prescribe is different from describe; no dose is specified here.
content.meaningVi: kê đơn; chỉ định điều trị

content.definitionEn: To officially state a rule or requirement that people must follow.

examples.en: The competition rules prescribe the size of every submitted model.
examples.vi: Thể lệ cuộc thi quy định kích thước của từng mô hình dự thi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Formal transitive use; prescribe a method or requirement; prescribe that something be done.

content.definitionEn: Without a paid job.

examples.en: After the factory closed, he was unemployed for several months.
examples.vi: Sau khi nhà máy đóng cửa, anh thất nghiệp trong vài tháng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually predicative; unemployed workers. The unemployed refers collectively to people without work.

content.definitionEn: The direction where the sun appears to set.

examples.en: The lake lies to the west of the railway station.
examples.vi: Hồ nằm về phía tây của nhà ga.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually the west; to the west of a place. Lowercase for a compass direction, unless part of a proper name.

content.definitionEn: On or towards the western side of a place.

examples.en: The west entrance remains open during the renovation.
examples.vi: Lối vào phía tây vẫn mở trong thời gian sửa chữa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Before a noun: west entrance, west coast. Western is also an adjective, with context-dependent usage.

content.definitionEn: In or towards the western direction.

examples.en: The walkers headed west after crossing the bridge.
examples.vi: Những người đi bộ hướng về phía tây sau khi qua cầu.

content.grammarNotesEn: Head west, travel west; no to is needed before this directional adverb.

content.definitionEn: The protection and careful management of wildlife and natural environments.

examples.en: The village supports forest conservation through a community nursery.
examples.vi: Ngôi làng hỗ trợ việc bảo tồn rừng thông qua một vườn ươm cộng đồng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; nature conservation, conservation of forests. Conservation need not mean excluding all human use.

content.definitionEn: Stories, beliefs and customs passed between generations within a community.

examples.en: The festival included a session on local folklore told by older residents.
examples.vi: Lễ hội có một buổi giới thiệu văn hóa dân gian địa phương do những cư dân lớn tuổi kể lại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; local folklore, a story from folklore. Broader than written folk literature alone.
content.meaningVi: văn hóa dân gian; truyện kể và tín ngưỡng dân gian

content.definitionEn: A product brought into a country from abroad.

examples.en: The shop placed local pottery beside imports from neighbouring countries.
examples.vi: Cửa hàng đặt đồ gốm trong nước cạnh hàng nhập khẩu từ các nước láng giềng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable, often plural imports for goods. Distinguish an import from the activity of import.

content.definitionEn: To bring goods into a country from another country.

examples.en: The company imports fabric from several overseas suppliers.
examples.vi: Công ty nhập khẩu vải từ một số nhà cung cấp ở nước ngoài.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: import goods from a country, import into a market. Opposite direction to export.

content.definitionEn: The activity of bringing goods into a country from abroad.

examples.en: The import of fresh produce requires careful transport planning.
examples.vi: Việc nhập khẩu nông sản tươi đòi hỏi lập kế hoạch vận chuyển cẩn thận.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable activity; the import of goods. In ordinary speech importing is also used.

content.definitionEn: A piece of jewellery designed to be worn around the neck.

examples.en: My aunt wore a silver necklace with a small leaf-shaped pendant.
examples.vi: Cô tôi đeo một dây chuyền bạc có mặt nhỏ hình chiếc lá.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a necklace, necklaces. A pendant is the hanging ornament, not necessarily the whole necklace.

content.definitionEn: To slide unexpectedly and lose firm contact with the surface beneath your feet.

examples.en: He slipped on the wet step but caught the handrail.
examples.vi: Anh trượt chân trên bậc thềm ướt nhưng kịp bám vào tay vịn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Intransitive; slip on a surface. Slipped and slipping double the final p; slipping does not always cause a fall.

content.definitionEn: An outdoor area next to a building, often enclosed.

examples.en: The children drew chalk patterns in the school yard.
examples.vi: Bọn trẻ vẽ những hình bằng phấn trong sân trường.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a yard, yards. Yard can be paved or unpaved; use depends on regional context.

content.definitionEn: A unit of length equal to three feet.

examples.en: The tailor measured a yard of blue cloth for the costume.
examples.vi: Người thợ may đo một thước Anh vải màu xanh lam để may trang phục.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a yard of cloth. Yard as a unit differs from an enclosed outdoor yard.
content.meaningVi: thước Anh, đơn vị chiều dài

content.definitionEn: Soft fibres from a cotton plant, used to make thread and fabric.

examples.en: The workers sorted the cotton before it was sent to the spinning mill.
examples.vi: Những người công nhân phân loại bông trước khi chuyển đến nhà máy kéo sợi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable material noun; raw cotton. The plant can be called a cotton plant.

content.definitionEn: Cloth made from cotton fibres.

examples.en: She chose light cotton for the summer curtains.
examples.vi: Cô chọn vải bông nhẹ để may rèm mùa hè.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable material noun; a cotton shirt uses cotton attributively. Fibre and fabric are related but distinct material stages.

content.definitionEn: In a way that is completely accurate or agrees fully with a stated amount or description.

examples.en: The two boards were exactly the same length.
