examples.vi: Hai tấm ván có chiều dài bằng nhau hoàn toàn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Exactly the same, exactly right; put exactly before the part whose precision is emphasized.

content.definitionEn: One of the organs in the chest that take air into the body during breathing.

examples.en: The diagram shows the position of each lung inside the chest.
examples.vi: Sơ đồ cho thấy vị trí của từng lá phổi bên trong lồng ngực.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a lung, two lungs. Often plural when discussing breathing.

content.definitionEn: According to information that has been reported, though not confirmed by the speaker.

examples.en: The missing statue was reportedly found in a private collection.
examples.vi: Theo nguồn tin, bức tượng bị mất đã được tìm thấy trong một bộ sưu tập tư nhân.

content.grammarNotesEn: Sentence adverb; reportedly does not establish that a report is true. Often used in news writing.
content.meaningVi: theo nguồn tin; được cho là

content.definitionEn: A written law formally passed by a body with lawmaking authority.

examples.en: The fictional council debated a proposal to revise an old statute.
examples.vi: Hội đồng trong truyện tranh luận về đề xuất sửa đổi một đạo luật cũ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a statute, statutes; under a statute. A statute is not a statue.

content.definitionEn: A message or sign that alerts someone to possible danger or trouble.

examples.en: The flashing light gave a warning that the battery was nearly empty.
examples.vi: Đèn nhấp nháy báo hiệu rằng pin sắp cạn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a warning about something, a warning of danger. A warning can be a signal rather than spoken words.
content.meaningVi: lời cảnh báo; dấu hiệu cảnh báo

content.definitionEn: A railway vehicle in which passengers travel.

examples.en: Our seats were in the last carriage of the morning train.
examples.vi: Chỗ ngồi của chúng tôi ở toa cuối của chuyến tàu buổi sáng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; railway carriage is common in British English; car is common in American English.

content.definitionEn: A vehicle pulled by horses and used to carry people.

examples.en: The restored carriage stood beside a photograph of its former owner.
examples.vi: Chiếc xe ngựa đã được phục chế được đặt cạnh ảnh của người chủ trước đây.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a horse-drawn carriage. Distinct from a railway carriage.

content.definitionEn: To make it harder for someone or something to move forward or succeed.

examples.en: Heavy traffic hindered the delivery of the new shelves.
examples.vi: Giao thông đông đúc cản trở việc giao những chiếc kệ mới.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: hinder progress; hinder someone from doing something. Hinder need not mean stop completely.

content.definitionEn: The feeling or opinion that a person or thing creates in someone.

examples.en: The carefully restored hall made a strong impression on the visitors.
examples.vi: Hội trường được phục chế cẩn thận tạo ấn tượng mạnh với khách tham quan.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: make an impression on someone; a first impression.

content.definitionEn: An idea about something formed without complete or certain information.

examples.en: I had the impression that the meeting would finish before lunch.
examples.vi: Tôi có cảm giác cuộc họp sẽ kết thúc trước bữa trưa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Have the impression that; be under the impression that. An impression is not necessarily a confirmed fact.
content.meaningVi: cảm giác; ý nghĩ chưa chắc chắn

content.definitionEn: To take the outer skin off fruit or vegetables.

examples.en: She peeled the carrots and cut them into thin strips.
examples.vi: Cô gọt vỏ cà rốt rồi cắt thành những dải mỏng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive: peel a carrot. Peeled and peeling; no peel noun is proposed in this boundary.
content.senseLabelEn: remove a fruit's or vegetable's skin

content.definitionEn: Causing surprise because it is not what someone expected.

examples.en: The quiet garden held a surprising variety of colourful birds.
examples.vi: Khu vườn yên tĩnh có nhiều loài chim sặc sỡ đến mức đáng ngạc nhiên.

content.grammarNotesEn: Surprising describes the cause; surprised describes the person's reaction. It is surprising that...

content.definitionEn: To remain somewhere or delay an action until someone arrives or something happens.

examples.en: We waited for the guide beside the ticket office.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi chờ hướng dẫn viên bên cạnh quầy vé.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually intransitive: wait for someone, wait to do something. Wait on has separate meanings.

content.definitionEn: A period during which someone has to wait.

examples.en: The wait for the next ferry lasted nearly an hour.
examples.vi: Thời gian chờ chuyến phà tiếp theo kéo dài gần một giờ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a long wait; a wait for something. Distinguish the noun from the imperative wait.

content.definitionEn: The ways that people or forces within a group or system affect one another and produce change.

examples.en: A new coordinator changed the dynamics of the small research team.
examples.vi: Một người điều phối mới làm thay đổi các mối tương tác trong nhóm nghiên cứu nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Plural noun in this sense: the dynamics are complex. The science called dynamics has different agreement and meaning.
content.meaningVi: các mối tương tác và tác động trong một nhóm hoặc hệ thống

content.definitionEn: Food and everyday household items bought from a shop.

examples.en: We carried the groceries home in two reusable bags.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi mang thực phẩm và đồ dùng mua được về nhà trong hai túi dùng lại được.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually plural groceries for the goods; grocery often modifies store or shopping.
content.meaningVi: thực phẩm và đồ dùng thiết yếu mua ở cửa hàng

content.definitionEn: Money given to someone on the agreement that they will repay it.

examples.en: The family used a small loan to replace the damaged roof.
examples.vi: Gia đình dùng một khoản vay nhỏ để thay mái nhà bị hỏng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: take out a loan, repay a loan. A loan is not a gift.

content.definitionEn: Used to introduce a fact that remains true despite what has just been said.

examples.en: The route was longer than expected; nevertheless, we arrived before sunset.
examples.vi: Tuyến đường dài hơn dự kiến; dù vậy, chúng tôi đến nơi trước khi mặt trời lặn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Linking adverb, often with a comma. Use a semicolon or full stop between independent clauses rather than a comma alone.

content.definitionEn: On very few occasions.

examples.en: The old clock seldom needed adjustment.
examples.vi: Chiếc đồng hồ cũ hiếm khi cần chỉnh lại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Frequency adverb, usually before the main verb. Initial seldom triggers inversion in formal clauses: seldom did they visit.

content.definitionEn: Measuring a large distance from one side to the other.

examples.en: The wide doorway allowed the table to pass through easily.
examples.vi: Ô cửa rộng giúp chiếc bàn được đưa qua dễ dàng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Wide, wider, widest; a metre wide. Width is the related noun.

content.definitionEn: The collection of sacred writings used in Christianity.

examples.en: The display included a Bible with handwritten notes in the margins.
examples.vi: Khu trưng bày có một cuốn Kinh Thánh với những ghi chú viết tay bên lề.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually capitalized Bible for the Christian scripture; the Bible for the collection, a Bible for a physical copy.

content.definitionEn: A group of organizations joined together for shared purposes while keeping some independence.

examples.en: Several cycling clubs formed a federation to organize regional races.
examples.vi: Một số câu lạc bộ xe đạp thành lập một liên đoàn để tổ chức các cuộc đua trong vùng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a federation of clubs. Member bodies retain some separate organization.

content.definitionEn: A country made up of states or regions that share a central government while retaining some powers of their own.

examples.en: In the fictional federation, each state managed its own school system.
examples.vi: Trong liên bang hư cấu, mỗi bang quản lý hệ thống trường học riêng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a federation of states. Not every international organization is a federation.

content.definitionEn: Beliefs about what behaviour is right or wrong.

examples.en: The story asks how personal morals influence difficult choices.
examples.vi: Câu chuyện đặt câu hỏi về cách các nguyên tắc đạo đức cá nhân ảnh hưởng đến những lựa chọn khó khăn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Plural noun: someone's morals. Distinguish from the moral of a story, its lesson.

content.definitionEn: To a noticeable but not extreme degree, especially in British English.

examples.en: The new reading room is quite spacious, though the main hall is larger.
examples.vi: Phòng đọc mới khá rộng rãi, dù hội trường chính rộng hơn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Before gradable adjectives or adverbs; the strength varies with context, intonation and variety of English.

content.definitionEn: Completely or entirely, especially with a word describing a complete state.

examples.en: Your guess was quite correct: the parcel contained the missing notebook.
examples.vi: Bạn đoán hoàn toàn đúng: gói bưu kiện chứa cuốn sổ bị thất lạc.

content.grammarNotesEn: Quite right, quite certain; not quite means not completely. Do not assume every use of quite has the same strength.

content.definitionEn: Able to do something well through knowledge or practice, or showing that ability.

examples.en: The skillful carpenter repaired the chair without changing its shape.
examples.vi: Người thợ mộc khéo léo sửa chiếc ghế mà không làm thay đổi hình dạng của nó.

content.grammarNotesEn: Skillful at doing something; skillful is usual American spelling, skilful usual British spelling.

content.definitionEn: A unit of language that carries meaning and can be spoken or written.

examples.en: The teacher wrote each new word beside a small drawing.
examples.vi: Giáo viên viết từng từ mới bên cạnh một hình vẽ nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a word, words; a word for something. This definition does not require every word to have spaces around it.

content.definitionEn: Very surprised by something unexpected or impressive.

examples.en: We were amazed at the detail in the tiny wooden model.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi kinh ngạc trước những chi tiết trong mô hình gỗ nhỏ xíu.

content.grammarNotesEn: Amazed at or by something; amazed to do, amazed that. Amazing describes the cause.

content.definitionEn: Goods transported in large quantities, especially by ship, train or truck.

examples.en: The train carried freight overnight while passenger services had stopped.
examples.vi: Đoàn tàu chở hàng hóa qua đêm trong khi các chuyến chở khách đã ngừng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; freight transport, a freight train. Freight names transported goods rather than passengers.

content.definitionEn: Following a clear and consistent line of reasoning.

examples.en: Her explanation gave a logical reason for changing the timetable.
examples.vi: Lời giải thích của cô đưa ra lý do hợp lý cho việc đổi thời gian biểu.

content.grammarNotesEn: A logical argument or conclusion; logical does not by itself guarantee that every starting assumption is true.

content.definitionEn: Belonging to a time before written records of history.

examples.en: The museum displayed prehistoric tools found near the river.
examples.vi: Bảo tàng trưng bày những công cụ thời tiền sử được tìm thấy gần sông.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a noun; prehistoric people or tools. The relevant period varies between regions.

content.definitionEn: To join or attach material by making stitches with a needle and thread.

examples.en: Grandmother sewed a new pocket onto my gardening apron.
examples.vi: Bà khâu thêm một chiếc túi mới vào tạp dề làm vườn của tôi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Sew, sewed, sewn or sewed; sew something onto something. Sewing can be by hand or machine.

content.definitionEn: Having the bright colour commonly seen in a ripe lemon.

examples.en: A yellow ribbon marked the path to the meeting place.
examples.vi: Một dải ruy băng màu vàng đánh dấu lối đến điểm hẹn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Yellow can precede a noun or follow be; yellowish means somewhat yellow.
content.senseLabelEn: having the colour of a lemon

content.definitionEn: The colour commonly seen in a ripe lemon.

examples.en: She added a little yellow to the green paint.
examples.vi: Cô thêm một ít màu vàng vào sơn màu xanh lá.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually uncountable for the colour; a yellow can refer to a particular shade.

content.definitionEn: Consisting of two similar parts or providing for two people.

examples.en: The studio has a double door opening onto the courtyard.
examples.vi: Xưởng có một cửa hai cánh mở ra sân.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before a noun: double door, double room. Exact meaning depends on the noun.
content.meaningVi: đôi; có hai phần tương tự

content.definitionEn: Twice as much or as many as a stated or understood amount.

examples.en: The larger pot holds double the amount of water.
examples.vi: Chiếc nồi lớn chứa lượng nước gấp đôi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Double the amount or double my salary; followed by a noun phrase identifying the quantity.
content.senseLabelEn: twice the amount before a noun

content.definitionEn: An amount that is twice another amount already understood.

examples.en: The first box held twelve tools, and the second held double.
examples.vi: Hộp thứ nhất chứa mười hai dụng cụ, còn hộp thứ hai chứa gấp đôi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Pronoun use stands without a following noun when the reference quantity is clear.

content.definitionEn: To become twice as large, or make something twice as large.

examples.en: The club doubled its membership after opening a weekend class.
examples.vi: Câu lạc bộ tăng gấp đôi số thành viên sau khi mở một lớp cuối tuần.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive or intransitive: double the number, the number doubled. Doubled is regular.
content.meaningVi: tăng gấp đôi; làm tăng gấp đôi
content.senseLabelEn: become or make twice as much

content.definitionEn: At twice the usual or stated amount.

examples.en: Visitors paid double during the special evening session.
examples.vi: Khách trả gấp đôi trong buổi đặc biệt vào tối đó.

content.grammarNotesEn: Pay double, cost double; modifies the verb rather than a following noun.

content.definitionEn: Accepted ways of behaving politely in a particular social setting.

examples.en: The guide explained dining etiquette before the formal meal.
examples.vi: Người hướng dẫn giải thích phép lịch sự khi ăn uống trước bữa ăn trang trọng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable; dining etiquette, rules of etiquette. Expectations vary by setting and culture.
content.meaningVi: phép lịch sự; nghi thức ứng xử

content.definitionEn: To twist together, or cause things to twist around one another.

examples.en: The bean stems intertwined around the wooden support.
examples.vi: Những thân cây đậu quấn vào nhau quanh giá đỡ bằng gỗ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive or intransitive; intertwine something with something; be intertwined. Also used figuratively for connected lives or issues.
content.meaningVi: đan vào nhau; quấn vào nhau

content.definitionEn: The remaining parts of buildings that have been destroyed or have fallen into disrepair.

examples.en: The path led to the ruins of a small stone tower.
examples.vi: Lối mòn dẫn đến tàn tích của một tháp đá nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Plural noun: the ruins of a building; the ruins are visible. Distinguish from uncountable ruin meaning destruction.

content.definitionEn: Towards a side rather than straight forwards or backwards.

examples.en: Move the cupboard sideways to clear the doorway.
examples.vi: Dịch chiếc tủ sang một bên để thông lối cửa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Move or step sideways; also sidewise in some usage. Sideways is not the same direction as backwards.
content.meaningVi: sang một bên; theo chiều ngang

content.definitionEn: During the time that another action or situation is happening.

examples.en: Whilst the soup simmered, I prepared the salad.
examples.vi: Trong khi súp sôi liu riu, tôi chuẩn bị món rau trộn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Whilst introduces a clause; mainly British English and often more formal than while.

content.definitionEn: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with the main statement.

examples.en: Whilst the design is simple, it is difficult to build accurately.
examples.vi: Mặc dù thiết kế đơn giản, việc dựng nó cho chính xác lại khó.

content.grammarNotesEn: Contrastive whilst is close to although; context distinguishes it from simultaneous-time whilst.

content.definitionEn: An area of a town or country with a particular boundary or character.

examples.en: The guide showed us the old market district near the river.
examples.vi: Người hướng dẫn đưa chúng tôi đến khu chợ cũ gần sông.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a shopping district or an administrative district. Vietnamese quận/huyện depends on the actual administrative system.

content.definitionEn: To recognize in advance that something may happen.

examples.en: The organizers foresaw delays and allowed extra time for the journey.
examples.vi: Ban tổ chức dự liệu việc chậm trễ và dành thêm thời gian cho hành trình.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; foresee something or foresee that; foresaw, foreseen. Foreseeing is anticipation, not certain knowledge of the future.

content.definitionEn: More and more as time passes.

examples.en: The library became increasingly popular after extending its opening hours.
examples.vi: Thư viện ngày càng được ưa chuộng sau khi kéo dài giờ mở cửa.

content.grammarNotesEn: Before an adjective or adverb; also before a main verb. Increasingly describes a trend rather than one fixed degree.

content.definitionEn: A piece of land surrounded by water on most sides but joined to a larger land area.

examples.en: A narrow road connects the peninsula's villages with the mainland.
examples.vi: Một con đường hẹp nối các làng trên bán đảo với phần đất liền chính.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a peninsula, peninsulas. A peninsula remains connected to land, unlike an island.

content.definitionEn: Serious and firm in expecting people to behave properly.

examples.en: The coach gave the noisy players a stern look.
examples.vi: Huấn luyện viên nhìn những cầu thủ ồn ào bằng ánh mắt nghiêm nghị.

content.grammarNotesEn: Stern look or warning; stern with someone. This adjective is distinct from the ship-part noun.

content.definitionEn: A substance that is solid at ordinary temperatures and softens or melts when heated, often used for candles or polish.

examples.en: The artist warmed the wax before shaping the small model.
examples.vi: Người nghệ sĩ làm ấm sáp trước khi tạo hình cho mô hình nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually uncountable material noun; a piece of wax. A wax can name a particular type.
content.senseLabelEn: solid substance that softens with heat

content.definitionEn: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.

examples.en: The new route is a better choice for cyclists.
examples.vi: Tuyến đường mới là lựa chọn tốt hơn cho người đi xe đạp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Comparative of good; better than, a better option. Do not use more better.

content.definitionEn: In a more successful, satisfactory or effective way.

examples.en: The class worked better after the desks were rearranged.
examples.vi: Lớp làm việc hiệu quả hơn sau khi các bàn được sắp xếp lại.

content.grammarNotesEn: Comparative of well; do something better, better than before. Better modifies the action here.

content.definitionEn: A more favourable state or outcome.

examples.en: The change in leadership was a change for the better.
examples.vi: Việc thay đổi người lãnh đạo là một sự thay đổi theo chiều hướng tốt hơn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Noun use is common in for the better. Do not generalize this pattern to an ordinary countable a better.
content.meaningVi: điều tốt hơn; sự cải thiện

content.definitionEn: Containing a lot of water vapour, especially of air or weather.

examples.en: The air felt humid after the afternoon shower.
examples.vi: Không khí có cảm giác ẩm sau cơn mưa rào buổi chiều.

content.grammarNotesEn: Humid air or weather; humidity is the noun. Humid does not necessarily mean a surface is wet.
content.senseLabelEn: having much moisture in the air

content.definitionEn: A compact piece of a solid substance, often with an uneven shape.

examples.en: A lump of clay remained at the bottom of the bucket.
examples.vi: Một cục đất sét còn lại ở đáy xô.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a lump of something. This material-piece sense does not identify a medical swelling.

content.definitionEn: The reddish-brown material that can form on iron or steel when it reacts with oxygen and moisture.

examples.en: Rust had formed around the old gate's hinges.
examples.vi: Rỉ sét đã hình thành quanh những bản lề của cánh cổng cũ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually uncountable; a patch of rust. Rusty is the adjective; rust also occurs as a verb, as in iron rusts.

content.definitionEn: Seriously affected by illness, distress or another harmful event.

examples.en: The storm-stricken village received blankets and clean water.
examples.vi: Ngôi làng chịu ảnh hưởng nặng nề của bão nhận được chăn và nước sạch.

content.grammarNotesEn: Often literary. Stricken with or by something; compounds include grief-stricken. Use struck for the ordinary past participle meaning hit.
content.meaningVi: bị ảnh hưởng nặng nề; lâm vào đau khổ

content.definitionEn: The part of life when someone is young.

examples.en: In her youth, my grandmother travelled between villages by bicycle.
examples.vi: Thời trẻ, bà tôi đi lại giữa các làng bằng xe đạp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable: in someone's youth. Youthful is the related adjective.

content.definitionEn: A boy or a young man.

examples.en: A youth from the village helped the visitors find the path.
examples.vi: Một thanh niên trong làng giúp khách tìm lối đi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable: a youth, youths, usually referring to a boy or young man. Often formal or disapproving; young man is more neutral.
content.meaningVi: nam thanh niên; chàng trai trẻ

content.definitionEn: Young people considered together as a social group.

examples.en: The council invited local youth to discuss the new sports centre.
examples.vi: Hội đồng mời giới trẻ địa phương thảo luận về trung tâm thể thao mới.

content.grammarNotesEn: Collective use; local youth or the youth of a place. Agreement can vary by construction and variety.

content.definitionEn: With intention rather than by accident.

examples.en: She deliberately left the final page blank for the reader's notes.
examples.vi: Cô chủ ý để trống trang cuối cho ghi chú của người đọc.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually before the main verb or after it for emphasis. Deliberately does not necessarily imply bad intentions.

content.definitionEn: To please someone strongly and hold their interest.

examples.en: The storyteller enchanted the audience with a tale about a wandering fox.
examples.vi: Người kể chuyện cuốn hút khán giả bằng câu chuyện về một con cáo lang thang.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive; enchant someone with something; be enchanted by. This delight sense differs from casting a magical spell.

content.definitionEn: Not working, active or in use at a particular time.

examples.en: The sewing machine stood idle while its owner waited for a new part.
examples.vi: Máy may không hoạt động trong lúc người chủ chờ một linh kiện mới.

content.grammarNotesEn: Idle equipment; remain or stand idle. Idle does not always mean a person is lazy.

content.definitionEn: Involving fewer working hours than a normal full-time schedule.

examples.en: Linh found a part-time job at the neighbourhood bookshop.
examples.vi: Linh tìm được một công việc bán thời gian tại hiệu sách trong khu phố.

content.grammarNotesEn: Hyphenated before a noun: part-time job. Exact hours depend on the work arrangement.
content.senseLabelEn: working fewer hours than a full schedule

content.definitionEn: For fewer working hours than a normal full-time schedule.

examples.en: He works part-time while attending an evening course.
examples.vi: Anh làm việc theo chế độ bán thời gian trong khi học một khóa buổi tối.

content.grammarNotesEn: Work part-time; hyphenated form is common. Do not infer a fixed weekly number of hours.
content.meaningVi: theo chế độ bán thời gian
